_note: When the carrier chooses to carry the ball (IDEA-DESIGN-010), he runs with it towards the opponent goal, this far, until his next decision; the ball goes where he goes. His pace is the movement formula's, as for every agent.
_source: Arbitrary, declared (2026-11-12, OI-97): about the distance a carrier covers in the 1-3 s of a decision at running pace. To be calibrated at L3. carry_stop_from_goal_cm 1650: the edge of the penalty area (Law 1, 16.5 m); a carrier stops there and chooses, he does not dribble onto the goal line.
